value: Part of a larger development on Set Universe Polymorphism, this article formalizes the concept of equivalences within Homotopy Type Theory (HoTT). It defines `IsEquiv`, a HoTT-style notion of equivalence, characterized by an inverse, section, retraction, and a critical adjointness coherence condition. The provided Coq development details the proof of `is_adjoint'`, demonstrating how this critical adjointness property can be rigorously derived from standard section and retraction equalities. This derivation enables the `isequiv_adjointify` lemma, a fundamental result for establishing that functions with standard section and retraction inverses indeed constitute full HoTT adjoint equivalences, which is essential for working with isomorphisms and building univalent structures.
